preliminary_finding: Prediction markets can aggregate dispersed information into useful market-generated forecasts.
relevance_to_argos: Supports M2 as an information-sensor baseline and makes incremental-over-M2 the correct hard test.

source: Cheong & Tamayo — Beyond the Wisdom of the Crowd: Concentrated Informed Trading in Earnings Prediction Markets
preliminary_finding: 2026 Polymarket earnings study reports prediction accuracy concentrated among a small number of large traders.
relevance_to_argos: Earnings cannot be dismissed as a low-information-asymmetry environment; participant concentration is theoretically relevant even though ARGOS H2 failed.
current_contractability_evidence: ARGOS frozen panel has 117 contracts; official Polymarket maintains recurring earnings contracts.

source: Rabetti; Shao; Zhang — Beating the Earnings Game: Why Do Prediction Markets Outperform Professional Analysts?
preliminary_finding: Study of 469 Polymarket firm-quarter observations reports prediction-market probabilities outperforming analyst consensus and attributes value to continuous aggregation/crowd mechanisms.
relevance_to_argos: Strengthens the case that aggregate probability may already be a strong information aggregator in earnings; does not authorize ARGOS sell-side superiority claim because our project did not reproduce their dataset/benchmark.
current_contractability_evidence: Dedicated recurring earnings contracts visible on Polymarket.

source: Demers & Vega — Soft Information in Earnings Announcements: News or Noise?
preliminary_finding: Soft textual information in earnings releases has incremental announcement impact and predicts post-earnings drift; response heterogeneity varies with size, turnover, media and analyst coverage.
relevance_to_argos: Shows the earnings information environment is heterogeneous and not exhausted by a single hard EPS statistic, but does not authorize post-hoc H3 subgroup rescue.

source: Brennan; Huh; Subrahmanyam — High-Frequency Measures of Informed Trading and Corporate Announcements
preliminary_finding: Finds evidence of informed trading around merger bids, dividend initiations, SEOs and quarterly earnings; some announcement news is incorporated pre-event.
relevance_to_argos: Supports information-diffusion mechanism across corporate event families and motivates cross-family comparison.

source: Lowry; Rossi; Zhu — Informed Trading by Advisor Banks: Evidence from Options Holdings
preliminary_finding: Finds significant advisor-bank options trading ahead of merger announcements but not similar stock trading.
relevance_to_argos: M&A has a strong information-asymmetry mechanism, but ex-ante PM contract creation may occur only after rumors and must be audited.
current_contractability_evidence: Official Polymarket acquisition category contains acquisition/announcement markets with heterogeneous liquidity.

source: Giglio & Shue — No News Is News: Do Markets Underreact to Nothing?
preliminary_finding: After merger announcement, passage of time contains information about completion probability and predicts returns.
relevance_to_argos: Deal-completion contracts offer a cleaner ex-ante contractable uncertainty with direct target-equity payoff mapping than secret-announcement events.
current_contractability_evidence: Official Polymarket lists deal-close/approval markets; historical census pending.

source: Wu; Borochin; Golec — Informed options trading before FDA drug advisory meetings
preliminary_finding: Reports abnormal options trading before FDA advisory meetings; experts receive nonpublic technical reports before public release.
relevance_to_argos: Strong information-asymmetry mechanism and concentrated single-name impact; requires enough early PM contracts/liquidity.
current_contractability_evidence: Official Polymarket FDA contract form exists; historical liquidity breadth pending census.

source: De Vany & McMillan — Was the Antitrust Action that Broke Up the Movie Studios Good for the Movies?
preliminary_finding: Stock-market event evidence identifies major antitrust court/regulatory decisions as economically material to affected firms.
relevance_to_argos: Supports linked-asset sensitivity for some antitrust/regulatory outcomes; modern repeated-sample contractability remains unproven.

source: MacKinlay-style legal event-study review — Event Studies and the Law Part I: Technique and Corporate Litigation
preliminary_finding: Reviews evidence that corporate litigation filings and settlements can generate economically meaningful and statistically significant wealth effects for defendant firms.
relevance_to_argos: Supports asset sensitivity of legal events while highlighting the need for narrow public-event timing and adequate sample size.
current_contractability_evidence: Historical PM census pending; objective resolution varies by case.

source: Prince & Rubin — The Effects of Product Liability Litigation on the Value of Firms
preliminary_finding: Product-liability litigation events are associated with significant firm-value losses and spillovers to competitors in some industries.
relevance_to_argos: Shows single-name legal outcomes can have concentrated financial transmission, but event standardization/contractability may be weak.

source: Park — Information in Yield Spread Trades
preliminary_finding: Bond-futures spread trades contain information about future macro activity and predict stock-price rises shortly before FOMC announcements.
relevance_to_argos: Shows macro announcement environments can contain heterogeneous/informed positioning and pre-event cross-asset price discovery.
current_contractability_evidence: Prediction markets are generally highly contractable for Fed/macro outcomes; systematic Gamma census pending.

source: Knox & Vissing-Jorgensen — The Effect of the Federal Reserve on the Stock Market: Magnitudes, Channels and Shocks
preliminary_finding: Surveys/extends evidence on narrow-window FOMC stock effects, pre-FOMC drift, FOMC cycle and communication channels.
relevance_to_argos: Supports strong market impact and timing relevance, but transmission is broad-market rather than clean single-name mapping.

source: Pasquariello & Vega — Informed and Strategic Order Flow in the Bond Markets
preliminary_finding: Unanticipated order flow has significant permanent impact on Treasury yields; informational effects vary with belief dispersion and public-signal noise.
relevance_to_argos: Supports information heterogeneity around macro news, while suggesting the natural linked assets may be rates/index products rather than single stocks.
